combinations.name: Telekinetic Sword
mechanics: Spirit projectiles cut through enemies faster and become longer.
For every 0.15 seconds reduction in Spirit cooldown, Damage Multiplier increases by 1.
For every 0.15 seconds reduction in Spirit cooldown, Attack Count increases by 1.

combinations.name: Blaster
mechanics: The 6th Magic Bolt fired has 7X power.

combinations.name: Current Overload
mechanics: Electric Shocks no longer chain, but are created 3 to 7 times in a row.
Electric Shock has longer range.

combinations.name: Prism Spray
mechanics: Instead of creating Arcane Rays on the opposite side, they are created at the same time in random directions 5 times in a row.
The Arcane Ray's Duration is converted into its Damage.

combinations.name: Terra Current
mechanics: Arcane Rays can attack targets in a wider range.
Arcane Rays switch directions every 0.5 seconds.
Arcane Ray gains 1X Damage Multiplier for every 1 sec of duration.

combinations.name: Avatar
mechanics: Summon 3 additional Mirages that fire Magic Bolts.
Mirages only fire 1 Magic Bolt at a time.
Each Magic Bolt increases Damage by 33%.

combinations.name: Brandish
mechanics: Flash Shock generates consecutively 7 times in all directions; for each cooldown reduction from 5 seconds to 0.5 seconds, Count increases by 1.
Flash Shock deals damage only at the Core.

combinations.name: Pyrotechnics
mechanics: Magic Bolt explodes at random locations.
Magic Bolt explosions expand, dealing 1-9X power.

combinations.name: Snowflake Blossom
mechanics: Frost Nova explodes consecutively 24 times near enemies, reducing Damage and Size by 2% per explosion.

combinations.name: Phoenix
mechanics: Tsunami is generated behind the character.
Tsunami leaves behind Flames along its path.
Revival count increases by 1.
penalties: Decrease the number of Tsunamis by 50%

combinations.name: Heart of Lightning
mechanics: Every time Electric Shock is chained, the projectile splits in 2 and their Damage and Size is decreased by 20%.
Electric Shock is chained at a higher speed.

combinations.name: Exidium
mechanics: Flash Shock core size increases.

combinations.name: Plasma Ray
mechanics: Arcane Ray is fixed at 4 and becomes permanent; for each 1-second reduction from 4 seconds cooldown, 1 Ray is added.
Arcane Ray Size and Duration are converted into Damage.
Arcane Ray deals damage every 0.25 seconds.
Arcane Ray Damage Multiplier increases by 1 per count.

combinations.name: Lightning Breath
mechanics: Electric Shocks are generated in front of the character by 3.

combinations.name: Hyperion
mechanics: An integrated Satellite is additionally generated on the opposite side; its Damage is 20% lower but causes Freeze on the first hit.
Damage increases proportionally to Satellite size.

combinations.name: Soul Blade
mechanics: Satellite transforms into a blade and rotates much faster.
Damage Multiplier and Rotation Speed increase in proportion to Satellite Critical Rate.

combinations.name: Ghastly Rampage
mechanics: Fireball pierces all enemies and moves randomly.
Fireball explodes with 3X power only when it disappears.
Fireball Damage increases proportionally to its duration.
Fireball Pierce value 1 increases Damage Multiplier by 3.

combinations.name: Crazed Spray
mechanics: Energy Bolts split into 4 and fire in all directions.
Energy Bolt projectiles continue moving forwards.
buffs: Increase the number of Energy Bolts by 3X

combinations.name: Frenzy
mechanics: Flash Shock generates faster and farther.
Casting Count Stacks start at 3 and reset at 7; for each cooldown reduction from 5 seconds to 0.5 seconds, Casting Count Stack increases by 1.

combinations.name: Neutron Generation
mechanics: All Cyclones are combined into one.
Cyclones no longer fire projectiles, but rapidly expand and their speed decreases gradually.
Each Cyclone increases the Size of the new Cyclone by 25%.

combinations.name: Black Hole
mechanics: Cyclone is unified into one.
Enemies hit by Cyclone become Staggered.
Cyclone cooldown starts after its duration ends.
Cyclone Duration Increase is converted into Damage 3X.
Cyclone Count increases Damage Multiplier by 3.

combinations.name: Inferno
mechanics: Incineration generates faster and increases Max Multiplier (Max Multiplier: Damage X30, Size X2).

combinations.name: Age of the Sun
mechanics: Lava Zones are simultaneously generated in all directions and move outward.
Convert Lava Zone duration per 1s into Damage Multiplier x3.

combinations.name: Furnace
mechanics: Lava Zones gradually expand.
Damage increases in relation to Lava Zone's duration.

combinations.name: Breath of Fire
mechanics: Incineration no longer fires sideways from the character, but to five directions outwards from the character.
Incinerations are created with longer range and at a faster speed.
buffs: Increase the number of Incinerations by 30%

combinations.name: Vortex
mechanics: Cyclones are created nearby the character and rotate.
Cyclones gradually shrink in size.

combinations.name: Ether Blaze
mechanics: Each Blizzard explosion splits into 2.

combinations.name: Ruler of Storms
mechanics: 3 Cyclones are created in a row in multiple directions.
The Cyclones' Movement Speed increases and then decreases gradually.

combinations.name: Flame Storm
mechanics: Meteor Craters no longer deal damage.
Meteors are generated in a line from the character in five directions, and their size changes; at each of 33%, 66%, and 99%, increase Direction Count by 1 and Damage Multiplier by 5.

combinations.name: Great Flood
mechanics: 2 additional Tsunamis are created on each side of the Tsunami.
Tsunamis are always created at the back of the character.

combinations.name: Winter Storm
mechanics: Blizzard explosions expand.
penalties: Decrease the number of Blizzards by 25%

combinations.name: Super Cyclone
mechanics: All Cyclones are combined into one.
Cyclones persist and follow the character.
Damage Multiplier increases in relation to how long Cyclones persist.
Cooldown starts when Cyclone's duration is over.
Each Cyclone increases the Size of the new Cyclone by 20%.

combinations.name: Lightning Calibration
mechanics: Electric Zones rotate around the character as multiple projectiles.
Electric Zones no longer have a Damage Interval but have increased Rotation Speed.

combinations.name: Magnetic Field
mechanics: The Rotation Speed bonus of Anti-Gravity is fixed to 2X.

combinations.name: Meisner Effect
mechanics: When EMP stuns a target, knock it back and deal 10X additional damage.

combinations.name: Gate
mechanics: Flash Shock Size Increase is converted into Damage.
buffs: Increase the number of Flash Shocks by 6X

combinations.name: Supernova
mechanics: Fires Spirit projectiles at once.

combinations.name: Genesis
mechanics: Blizzard Cooldown becomes faster in proportion to the number, and the Generation Interval becomes equal to the Cooldown.

combinations.name: Black Death
mechanics: Fireballs instantly explode at random locations, dealing damage 4 times.
Damage increases proportionally to Fireball size.
Convert Fireball Piercing to 50% of Count.

combinations.name: Glacium
mechanics: Tsunami spreads outward in all directions from the character.
buffs: Increase the number of Tsunamis by 25%

combinations.name: Genocide
mechanics: Arcane Rays are unified into one and spin faster.
Arcane Ray Size Increase is converted into Damage.
Arcane Ray Count increases Damage Multiplier by 4 each.

combinations.name: Origin Explosion
mechanics: Energy Bolts immediately explode after spreading in all directions.
Damage and Quantity of Energy Bolts increase based on their duration.
buffs: Increase Energy Bolt Explosion Size by 50%

combinations.name: Hellfire
mechanics: Incineration generates 2X.
Incineration Flames explode consecutively 2-3 times.

combinations.name: Discharge
mechanics: When Electric Shock explodes, its size increases and it releases Projectiles.

combinations.name: Astrape
mechanics: When a Thunderstorm explodes, it releases a shock wave around the area, dealing half damage to nearby enemies and stunning them.

combinations.name: Empyrean Wrath
mechanics: The Thunderstorm's explosion covers a wider range but does not expand.
buffs: Increase the number of Thunderstorms by 3X

combinations.name: Lightning Bolts
mechanics: 5 Thunderstorms are created in a row at random locations.
Each Thunderstorm increases the new Thunderstorm's Creation Radius and Number by 30%.

combinations.name: War Climate
mechanics: Meteor Cooldown becomes faster depending on the number of Meteors, and they are also created over the same interval as its Cooldown.
Meteor Cooldown is also decreased by 0 to 80% for each Meteor.

combinations.name: Energy Bombardment
mechanics: Multiple Arcane Rays are created in random directions at once.
Arcane Rays do not rotate anymore.

combinations.name: Great Impact
mechanics: Meteor is generated consecutively 3 times, and the first Meteor's Power is increased by 50%.

combinations.name: Mana Spear
mechanics: The Spirit now uses its default Cooldown and Launch Interval.
Spirit Projectile Speed and Range is increased dramatically.

combinations.name: Demon Equation
mechanics: Fireballs are launched at the same time in multiple directions and the attribute effect Big Bang will no longer be active.
buffs: Increase the number of Fireballs by 4X

combinations.name: Great Rift
mechanics: Enemies hit by Frost Nova are all Knocked Back.
Frost Nova Damage increases proportionally to its Size.

combinations.name: Orbital Strike
mechanics: Thunderstorms are quickly generated near a set location.

combinations.name: Destroyer
mechanics: Electric Zone is given a Cooldown of 5 seconds.
Electric Zone is given a Duration of 3 seconds.
penalties: Decrease HP Regen per sec. by 0.1%

combinations.name: Frozen Heart
mechanics: Electric Zone briefly Freezes enemies.
Each activation of Electric Zone increases Damage and Size multiplier by 1 and resets at 4 activations.

combinations.name: Reaction
mechanics: Energy Bolts are generated in all directions.
Energy Bolts explode at intervals of 0.5 seconds, and each explosion increases their power by 20%.
penalties: Decrease the number of Energy Bolts by 50%

combinations.name: Photon Explosion
mechanics: The Shield explodes instead of charging up.
Damage and Size of Shields increase by 33% per Shield.
Damage increases in relation to All Magic Size Increase.

combinations.name: Teleport
mechanics: Cast Cloaking 7 times in succession to teleport randomly and return to the original position at the end.
Cast Count and Damage Multiplier of Cloaking increase based on its duration.

combinations.name: Gate of Creation
mechanics: For each activated Combination Magic, ATK is Amplified by 20%.
Gain 2 more Magic Combination chance.
Increase Max Level by 5.
buffs: Amplify ATK by 20% per Combination Magic

combinations.name: Perpetual Engine
mechanics: Magic Circles are permanent.
The Magic Circle's Effect is increased by 1% for every 3% of its Duration.
The Magic Circle's Effect is increased by 1% for every 3% of its Cooldown Decrease.

combinations.name: Overmind
mechanics: Only Combined Spells can be cast.
For each level of acquired Active Magic, Amplify ATK by 1.5%, Increase All Magic Size by 0.5%, and Decrease All Magic Cooldown by 0.3%.
buffs: Amplify ATK by 1.5% per Active Magic level
Increase All Magic Size by 0.5% per Active Magic level
Decrease All Magic Cooldown by 0.3% per Active Magic level
penalties: Only Combined Spells can be cast
